name: Hime nochi Honey
source:
Because my family were poor, I've always wanted to live in the glamorous city with Shintarou.
A certain incident occurs and I get to know the board chairman of a gorgeous school, and fate lets me get into the same school.

Great!

I hope to start my new life here with Shintarou, but the students are from another world.
All the heroines are beyond reach.

Despite this, I hope love will overcome.
